name: Marti Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Marti Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. engages in the real estate activities in Turkey. The company primarily has investments in Çerkezköy housing project; a hotel in Sarigerme; and two hotels in Ayin Bay and Hisarönü Marina. Marti Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
